theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_flat_seq_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (X Pc S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), X k ω - Pc k ω = (R k).boundary ω + S k ω) → Tendsto (fun k => (R k).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun k => (S k).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Tendsto (fun k => Pc k ω - X k ω) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
